title: A Release for This Vehicle: Only When It Is Parked and Charged, Never With Another Vehicle's Calibration, and Kept Only If It Drives Properly

questions.question: Why is an update refused when the vehicle is not parked?
options: It is a reboot, and a reboot of a moving vehicle is a stop and a lost mission

questions.question: A vehicle that was moving, in a mission and at 20 percent charge was refused for how many reasons?
A track width of 0.40 m taken for 0.25 m makes a skid steer turn:
A release that failed its self test was rolled back after how many boots?
questions.explanation: Three tries, then the old slot.

questions.question: What does only a self test pass do?
questions.explanation: The release does not get to say it is fine.

questions.question: Why is a charge that is not a number counted as low?
options: A comparison with it is false, so it must fail the check
questions.explanation: Written as 'soc >= minimum', so NaN fails.
